name: Guess 2/3 of the average
summary: Players simultaneously pick numbers trying to be closest to two-thirds of the group average.
rules_text: Each player privately chooses a real number between 0 and 100 inclusive. All choices are revealed at the same time. Compute the arithmetic mean of all chosen numbers, then multiply by 2/3 to get the target number. The player whose chosen number is closest to the target wins. If several players are equally close, they tie for the win. The game is played once, though it can be repeated to study learning.
rating_reason: Simultaneous numeric prediction, arithmetic ranking ideal
